description: This file defines the data structures for a Live Activity feature in an iOS app using ActivityKit. It includes the main attributes class `OpenClawActivityAttributes` with nested state `ContentState`, along with some preview data for debugging.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes
classes.description: A struct conforming to `ActivityAttributes`, representing the shared schema used for Live Activity in the iOS app and widget extension.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: A static property providing a preview instance of `OpenClawActivityAttributes` for debugging purposes.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState
classes.description: A nested struct conforming to `Codable` and `Hashable` that holds the current state information of the activity, such as status text and various boolean flags indicating connection/status.

methods.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.preview
methods.description: Provides a sample instance of `OpenClawActivityAttributes` for debugging and preview purposes.

methods.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState.connecting
methods.description: Static instance representing a connecting state with predefined attribute values.

methods.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState.idle
methods.description: Static instance representing an idle state.

methods.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState.disconnected
methods.description: Static instance representing a disconnected state.
